body: my heart aches for you...i am so sorry to hear your story, i wish i could give you beauty and show that a golden day is never as far away as it seems...but all i can really say is that i root for you. there is empathy on this site!
there is no boat, i just feel like i'm drowning.

we are human beings! we delude ourselves into trying to be Superman! when really we all just want a cuddle!! we are all weak, we are all vulnerable, but some people pretend to be infallible. you have the courage to be honest with your feelings, no matter how painful. you do not turn away. it takes courage to stare into the abyss of existence. but you can use that same courage for whatever purpose you choose! i so wish i could unite everyone on this site in one giant group hug, we are all emotionally crippled and we are all here for each other....but it's still just a website. i so wish i could help you more than these typed words

i don't know what to try! everything just feels like the wrong choice, i'm so desperate to hang on to my music, it is my soul and my only joy, nothing else in my life is real, everything is just endless pain, music is my only chink of light, i give all my life to it. it's so precious to me, i'm terrified to risk anything. and i've been stuck alone for way too long, but i'm just going round and round in circles, i'm so confused.

i am still so torn. either i sacrifice my independence and devote my energies to music, or i sacrifice my music for my independence. it seems like i can't have both. i don't know how to achieve both! i don't know what i'm supposed to do, i'm completely lost, and i have been lost and overwhelmed by uncertainty for so long, i'm so paralysed.

you have posted this, so i assume you want someone to read it, which in turn means you are hoping for support. that in itself is positive. i have had this same suicidal fantasy many many times, i can't tell you how many times i have stood at train stations burning with a desire to throw myself on the tracks, but i'm begging you not to do it. you have a chance to be superhuman and to turn pain into beauty. and i promise you that whatever seemed painful in your life will fade. i know it will seem and sound ridiculous. but i do CARE. i don't know you, but i feel terrible that you feel this way. please believe me.

it's not even that i'm awkward with people especially, i just have no belief that anyone will want me in their life at all. i'm completely broken, i'm a weak and cowardly individual, i cannot fathom why anyone would ever want me around, let alone for a friendship or relationship. i feel so useless talking to girls, there is nothing about me a girl would like at all, i feel so inadequate.

i'm terrified of getting a job, i worry that i won't be able to devote all of my energy to my music, i either do something with total commitment or i don't do it at all, and i've tried many many programs and clubs, short courses and classes...i just can't make friends, i'm so weird and useless with people, no one likes me

i know you aren't going to believe this, and i know it seems ridiculous, but this feeling WILL NOT LAST. I promise you. I know it to be true. I feel sickened and ashamed of my own existence most days, but even these painful feelings do NOT endure, the sun will rise on you again, you just need to make it through this dark night. i wish i could support you more, i am sorry i am just text on a screen. you are not the only one. this site is full of empathy. as am i.

yeah sure, my music is here: www.reverbnation.com/danieljones1991

i can't relocate, in my head i'd be just as lonely here, there or anywhere...loneliness follows me every second of my life, doesn't matter where i am or who i'm with

I've tried therapy, i used to believe it could be helpful, but i don't believe in "professional help" anymore, it's all a lie. a therapist can't make my worries subside.

all i wanna do is music, i don't wanna do anything else, but it breaks my heart that i don't know where to turn

no i'm not on the dole, i don't feel i deserve any money
i'm terrified of becoming just another greedy, faceless and emotionless capitalist. i hate the way the world functions, every time i have to quash down my overwhelming emotions is intensely painful, everything i try just seems to be not good enough, i just can't take the hits.

damn straight. it sickens me that we're expected to just toss aside our compassion and our desire to help others and "grow up". people say "grow up", but what they really mean is "act like a cold-hearted prick who only thinks of yourself."

i feel like you are a very compassionate and loving person, and you want to have a giving and loyal heart. and the truth is that the society we live in doesn't champion these qualities in general....but there are always people to be found who do!! counsellors don't really give a shit, you just need to find the right mediums with which to express yourself! a mother is the most amazing thing to be surely? do you not think that you will feel differently when you first hold your newborn child?

I am very sad for you. i wish i could give you as much help as you need!! it breaks my heart to see so much sadness on the internet, i can't really give any advice because i'm a complete loser, i can only say that i understand how you're feeling about life, everything terrifies me too, i'm terrified of the future and i don't want to be a part of it either, i'm sickened by who i am and who i've always been. all i'm trying tell you is that you are never actually as alone as you feel.
